point: Where asks for a place.
Where 問地點。
why: The question is Where's the orientation for the new interns being held? Only one reply gives a place: In the training room next to the cafeteria.
問題是 Where's the orientation … being held?，只有一個回應給出地點：In the training room next to the cafeteria。

gloss.ex: The orientation starts at nine in the main hall.
We hired two interns for the summer.
Lunch is served in the cafeteria.
The event is being held downtown.

point: A statement: pick the reply that explains the problem.
敘述句：選能解釋問題的回應。
why: The man can't open the spreadsheet. Martin was editing it a few minutes ago suggests Martin may still have the file open, which would block others.
男方說 can't open 試算表。Martin was editing it a few minutes ago 暗示 Martin 可能還開著檔案，別人就打不開。

gloss.ex: The quarterly meeting is on Monday.
Please update the spreadsheet before noon.
Save the file on the shared drive.

point: An either/or question can get an indirect answer.
二選一問句可以得到間接回答。
why: He asks about taking the train… or driving. Parking near the exhibition center is really expensive is a reason not to drive, so she will take the train.
他問 taking the train … or driving。Parking near the exhibition center is really expensive 是不開車的理由，所以她會搭火車。

gloss.ex: Our firm has a booth at the trade fair.
The exhibition center is next to the station.
Parking is free for guests.

point: A negative question: answer it as yes or no.
否定問句：照 Yes/No 回答。
why: He asks Haven't the new name badges come in yet? No, they should be here by Friday says they have not arrived; be here matches come in.
他問 Haven't the new name badges come in yet?。No, they should be here by Friday 表示還沒到，be here 對應 come in。

gloss.ex: Please wear your name badge at all times.
The new stock should come in on Friday.

point: A tag question: answer it as yes or no.
附加問句：照 Yes/No 回答。
why: She asks You're presenting… aren't you? That's right means yes, and I'll be the first speaker says the same thing in other words.
她問 You're presenting … aren't you?。That's right 就是 yes，I'll be the first speaker 用另一種說法再說一次。

gloss.ex: She will present the results on Monday.
The budget meeting runs until noon.

point: An indirect answer: the work is still in progress.
間接回答：事情還在進行中。
why: She asks When will the new price list be ready? Monica is still checking the numbers gives no date, but it means the list is not ready yet.
她問 When will the new price list be ready?。Monica is still checking the numbers 沒給日期，但表示清單還沒好。

gloss.ex: Send the new price list to all clients.
Please check the numbers once more.
The hotel offers reasonable rates.

point: An indirect answer: a reason that means 'not yet'.
間接回答：用理由表示「先不要」。
why: He asks whether to send the contract today. The lawyers haven't finished going over it means the review is not done, so he should wait.
他問今天要不要寄合約。The lawyers haven't finished going over it 表示還沒審完，所以要先等。

gloss.ex: Both sides signed the contract on Friday.
Please go over the terms before you sign.
Our lawyers reviewed the agreement.

point: An indirect answer: 'I don't know either.'
間接回答：「我也不知道」。
why: She asks How do I get to the staff kitchen from here? Sorry, it's only my first week shows he is new too, so he cannot give directions.
她問 How do I get to the staff kitchen from here?。Sorry, it's only my first week 表示他也是新來的，沒辦法指路。

gloss.ex: How do I get to the bank?
The staff kitchen is on the third floor.

point: A Who question can be answered with 'not decided yet'.
Who 問句可以回答「還沒決定」。
why: She asks Who's going to lead the safety training after Ms. Harlan retired. That's on the agenda for Monday's meeting means it will be decided then.
她問 Harlan 退休後 Who's going to lead the safety training。That's on the agenda for Monday's meeting 表示到時才會決定。

gloss.ex: She will lead the workshop on Friday.
Our manager retired last spring.
Add this topic to the agenda.

point: A Why question can be answered with a question.
Why 問句可以用反問回答。
why: She asks Why is the parking garage closed today? Didn't you see the e-mail from the building manager? suggests the e-mail already gives the reason.
她問 Why is the parking garage closed today?。Didn't you see the e-mail from the building manager? 暗示原因信裡已經寫了。

gloss.ex: The parking garage opens at seven.
Ask the building manager about the key.

point: A statement can be answered by asking about the cause.
敘述句可以用追問原因來回應。
why: He says The quarterly figures still don't add up. Did you include the April returns? points to a number that may be missing.
他說 The quarterly figures still don't add up.。Did you include the April returns? 指出可能漏算的數字。

gloss.ex: These numbers do not add up.
The sales figures look strong.
Returns rose after the holiday sale.
The board will vote on Friday.

point: A request can be declined with a reason.
請求可以用理由婉拒。
why: He asks her to show the new designer how to use the booking system. She used the same one at her last job means the designer already knows it.
他請她 show the new designer how to use the booking system。She used the same one at her last job 表示設計師已經會用。

gloss.ex: The booking system shows all open rooms.
The designer sent us three samples.

point: Main topic: check the first lines.
主旨題：看開頭幾句。
why: The man opens with our department is moving to the fifth floor next month. That is a team relocation.
男方開頭說 our department is moving to the fifth floor next month，也就是團隊搬遷。

point: Match the detail to the moving company.
細節題：對應 moving company。
why: She says A moving company will handle the furniture and computers. Moving furniture and computers is transporting office equipment.
她說 A moving company will handle the furniture and computers。搬運家具和電腦就是運送辦公設備。

point: A request: listen for Could you, and find what 'mine' means.
請求題：聽 Could you，並找出 mine 指什麼。
why: He asks Could you leave mine on my chair? Mine means his share of the boxes and labels she will hand out, so he wants packing materials set aside.
他問 Could you leave mine on my chair?。Mine 指她要發的 boxes and labels 中他的那份，所以他要她留下打包用品。

gloss.ex: We will pack up the office on Thursday.
A moving company carried the heavy desks.
Our assistant will handle the booking.
Put a label on each box.

point: Infer the workplace from what he sells.
場所題：從他賣的東西推工作地點。
why: He says Each of our platters serves six and gives a price per platter. He sells food for events, so he works at a catering business.
他說 Each of our platters serves six 並報每盤價格。他賣活動用的餐點，所以在外燴業者工作。

point: Find the problem the man raises.
細節題：找男方提出的問題。
why: She wants delivery by 11:30, but he says our driver doesn't start deliveries until noon. The order cannot arrive in time.
她要 by 11:30 前送到，但他說 our driver doesn't start deliveries until noon。訂單趕不上時間。

point: The decision comes in her last turn.
細節題：決定在她最後一次發言。
why: She says I'll send my assistant to collect them. A staff member will pick up the food.
她說 I'll send my assistant to collect them。也就是由員工去取餐。

gloss.ex: We ordered two sandwich platters.
I'm afraid the room is already booked.
The bank is just around the corner.
You can collect your order at noon.

point: A quoted line: ask what it replies to.
引句題：看它在回應什麼。
why: He proposes working on it this afternoon. She answers I've got a dentist appointment at three, so she will not be free later in the afternoon.
他提議 this afternoon 一起看。她回 I've got a dentist appointment at three，表示下午晚一點沒空。

point: Join two lines and see who did what.
細節題：兩句接起來，分清誰做了什麼。
why: She says Tom went over it yesterday about the back page, and he confirms it is The page with all the prices. Tom reviewed the cost information.
她說封底 Tom went over it yesterday，他確認那頁是 The page with all the prices。Tom 看過了價格資訊。

point: Listen for the man's I'll.
細節題：聽男方的 I'll。
why: The man ends with I'll book a meeting room for one o'clock. Book means reserve a room.
男方最後說 I'll book a meeting room for one o'clock。book 就是預訂會議室。

gloss.ex: The print shop delivers on Tuesday.
We will go through the list together.
We will meet straight after the call.
We will go over the contract twice.
Please mark any changes in red.

point: An idiom: use the sentence before it.
引句題：用前一句判斷慣用語。
why: She says the laptops were promised… this spring, but I'm not holding my breath. She does not expect them to arrive as promised.
她說筆電 promised … this spring, but I'm not holding my breath，意思是她不期待會照承諾送到。

point: Find what he offers to do.
細節題：找他提出要做的事。
why: He says I'll bring a battery up to your desk this afternoon. That is delivering a part to her workspace.
他說 I'll bring a battery up to your desk this afternoon，也就是把零件送到她的座位。

point: The next step comes at the end.
下一步題：答案在結尾。
why: He says the model number is On a silver sticker on the bottom, and she answers I'll turn it over. She will check the underside.
他說型號在 On a silver sticker on the bottom，她回 I'll turn it over。她會檢查底部。

gloss.ex: The computer keeps shutting down by itself.
The company handed out new phones.
I'm not holding my breath for a raise.
We keep spares in the storeroom.
Please read me the model number.

point: Purpose: listen for 'mainly'.
目的題：聽 mainly。
why: At the start she says the buyers mainly want to see our new packaging line in action. They want to watch new equipment run.
開頭她說買方 mainly want to see our new packaging line in action。他們要看新設備運作。

point: 'That day' points back to the day just named.
跨說話者：that day 指前面剛提的日子。
why: The first woman suggests Friday. The other woman answers That day won't work. The painters have the whole production floor booked, so visitors cannot enter part of the facility.
第一位女士提議 Friday。另一位回 That day won't work. The painters have the whole production floor booked，所以訪客不能進入部分廠區。

point: Find who Hannah is, then follow 'them'.
三人對話：先找出 Hannah 是誰，再追 them。
why: She asks Hannah, can you take care of the safety gear? and tells her to order new ones today from the supplier. Hannah replies I'll call them, so she will contact a vendor.
有人問 Hannah, can you take care of the safety gear? 並要她 order new ones today 向供應商訂貨。Hannah 回 I'll call them，所以她會聯絡供應商。

gloss.ex: The packaging line runs all day.
The plant will shut down for repairs.
Maintenance starts at six in the morning.
The repair work may run over.
These gloves are worn out.

point: A reason: the real one follows 'but'.
原因題：but 後面才是真正的理由。
why: He says I'd like to, but my manager asked me to go to the one right after it. His supervisor wants him at a different session.
他說 I'd like to, but my manager asked me to go to the one right after it。主管要他去另一場。

point: Graphic: find the next session in the table.
圖表題：到表上找下一場。
why: Contracts is at 1:00 P.M. He goes to the one right after it, which is the 2:30 P.M. row, Leading Remote Teams, in Room 310. It fits the work-from-home policy.
合約場在 1:00 P.M.。他去 the one right after it，也就是表上 2:30 P.M. 那列 Leading Remote Teams，在 Room 310，也符合在家工作政策。

point: The next step: 'it' is the badge.
下一步題：it 指識別證。
why: He says I'll head up there and get it now. It is the badge she asked about, so he will pick up his conference pass.
他說 I'll head up there and get it now。It 指她問的 badge，所以他要去拿識別證。

gloss.ex: The work-from-home policy starts in May.
Please show your badge at the door.
The registration desk opens at eight.
Have you picked up your tickets?
We talked between sessions.

point: Main topic: listen to the opening lines.
主旨題：聽開頭幾句。
why: a contractor will be replacing those elevators. Replacing old elevators means installing new ones.
a contractor will be replacing those elevators。換掉舊電梯就是安裝新電梯。

point: A reason: 'those elevators' points back.
原因題：those elevators 往前指。
why: Those elevators will be very busy between 8:30 and 9:00, so… come in a little earlier. They are the main-entrance elevators still in use, so they will be crowded.
Those elevators will be very busy between 8:30 and 9:00, so … come in a little earlier. 它們是仍可使用的大門旁電梯，所以會很擠。

point: Notice who the offer is for.
細節題：注意提供對象。
why: the front desk can give you a pass for the freight elevator. A freight elevator is a service elevator, so the pass gives access to it.
the front desk can give you a pass for the freight elevator。貨梯就是 service elevator，通行證讓人可以使用。

gloss.ex: The contractor will finish by June.
Boxes go up in the freight elevator.
Signs show the temporary routes.
Can you manage the stairs with that box?
Thank you for your patience.

point: Infer who the listener is from 'your talk'.
推論題：從 your talk 推聽者身分。
why: She says I'm confirming your talk on Thursday. Mr. Wei will give the talk, so he is a guest speaker.
她說 I'm confirming your talk on Thursday。Mr. Wei 要演講，所以是受邀講者。

point: Listen for 'instead of'.
細節題：聽 instead of。
why: She says it will run 40 minutes instead of 30. The talk is longer, so he will have more time to speak.
她說 40 minutes instead of 30。演講變長，他有更多時間可講。

point: Purpose: see what follows the remark.
意圖題：看這句話後面接什麼。
why: She says the garage fills up early, then If you'd like a reserved space, just let me know by Wednesday. She suggests he reserve parking in advance.
她說停車場 fills up early，接著說 If you'd like a reserved space, just let me know by Wednesday。她建議他提前預約車位。

gloss.ex: Please confirm your seat by Friday.
The venue holds two hundred people.
Send me your slides before the talk.
A technician will set up the projector.
We keep a reserved space for guests.

point: Infer the audience from 'our store'.
身分題：從 our store 推聽眾。
why: She says our store is switching to a new inventory system and you'll be off the sales floor all day. The listeners work in the store.
她說 our store is switching to a new inventory system 和 you'll be off the sales floor all day。聽眾是店裡的員工。

point: A quote that denies a mistake.
引句題：這句話否認出錯。
why: Six hours looks like an error, so she says That's not a typo and explains the trainer wants to cover everything in a single day. The sessions really are that long.
六小時看起來像寫錯，所以她說 That's not a typo，並解釋講師要 in a single day 教完所有內容。課真的那麼長。

point: Find the deadline word 'by Friday'.
細節題：找 by Friday。
why: She says Please sign up for one on the sheet… by Friday. There are three dates, so signing up means choosing a session date.
她說 Please sign up for one on the sheet … by Friday。要在三個日期中選一場，也就是選場次日期。

gloss.ex: The inventory system tracks every item.
I found a typo in the title.
Staff are needed on the sales floor.
Please sign up for the workshop.
The desk stays covered at lunch.
